subject: TARGET CLAIM: hinge-ingress edge preservation across main-thread coalescing
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-hinge-ingress-edge-preservation-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339.
